description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class named WorkShiftStartAndEndTime within the OrangeHRM project. The class encapsulates start and end times for work shifts, represented as DateTime objects, providing constructor, getter, and setter methods.

classes.name: WorkShiftStartAndEndTime
classes.description: A DTO class that stores the start and end times of a work shift as DateTime objects, with associated getter and setter methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new WorkShiftStartAndEndTime with specified start and end times.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time for the work shift.

methods.name: setStartTime
methods.description: Sets the start time for the work shift.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: Returns the end time for the work shift.

methods.name: setEndTime
methods.description: Sets the end time for the work shift.
